## What this PR does

One sentence. Link the issue it closes.

## How to test it

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run lint
```

What to click to see the change. Screenshots for visual changes, a screen recording for animated ones.

## Risks

Anything that could break. The library schema change, the parser behaviour change, etc.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Linter passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Library schema validates (`npm run validate:library`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Visual change has a screenshot
- [ ] New files have licence headers
- [ ] No new external CDN calls
